tagline.zh: 任何项目都能变成一堂实训课：项目打成镜像放进镜像广场，学生一键拿到能跑的真实系统；教师建课分组，过程与成绩留痕。
tagline.en: Turn any project into a hands-on course: projects are packaged as images in a marketplace, so each student gets a running system in one click, while teachers run modules and groups with grading on record.

tagline.zh: 东源县革命遗址导览平台：遗址图文详情、条件筛选、语音导览、导览路线与知识问答，配套管理后台维护内容。已交付为微信小程序。
tagline.en: A guide to the revolutionary heritage sites of Dongyuan County: illustrated entries, filters, audio guides, suggested routes and quizzes, with an admin console behind it. Delivered as a WeChat mini-program.
